title: Copilot Studio: self-learning recommendations to refine agents
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned maker-reviewed recommendations and stale target dates. The current Microsoft documentation supports the access entitlements, background billing rates and monthly agent-limit control; searches did not find feature-specific settings or charges.

claims.claim: Billable standard-harness reasoning-model usage adds 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 billed tokens to the feature rate.
claims.quote: Total cost = feature rate for the operation + text and generative AI tools (premium) for the reasoning model's token usage. ... Copilot Credits are calculated from the exact number of billed tokens, at 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 tokens.

claims.claim: Tokens read from the prompt cache are excluded from reasoning-model billed tokens.
claims.quote: Input tokens that the model reads from its prompt cache | No

claims.claim: Eligible authenticated Microsoft 365 Copilot employee-facing standard-harness usage is included in that user's license.
claims.quote: Employee-facing usage scenarios (Business to Employee) ... are included in the Microsoft 365 Copilot user subscription license (USL) when the user of the agent is licensed with Microsoft 365 Copilot, and the agent operates using the authenticated Microsoft 365 Copilot USL user's identity.

claims.claim: The included usage is subject to fair usage limits.
claims.quote: The "No charge" inclusion doesn't apply to agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Usage is limited to fair usage limits.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Agent flow actions are billed and checked for capacity separately from the parent agent.
claims.quote: Agent flows are billed and checked for capacity separately from the agent that calls them.

claims.claim: The standard-harness billing FAQ says an agent's own test-chat activity does not consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: When you test an agent in the test chat, the agent's own activity, such as classic answers, generative answers, agent actions, and tenant graph grounding, doesn't consume Copilot Credits and isn't included in Copilot Credit consumption reports.

claims.claim: The FAQ describes features used in standard-harness agents and agent flows.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness.

claims.claim: Building, testing, evaluating and running Microsoft Copilot harness agents can consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness use consumption-based billing. Building, testing, evaluating, and running these agents can consume Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit is set in Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio. ... Select Manage Agents. ... Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: No API for setting this per-agent monthly limit was documented in the searched Learn references.
claims.quote: Searched: "monthly" "agent" "limit" "Power Platform API"; Copilot Studio agent credit limit Set-AdminPowerApp PowerShell administration module API licensing resource settings. Opened pac admin, bot table and capacity references; no matching operation or limit column found.

claims.claim: The monthly limit's hard stop is optional and uses Stop usage.
claims.quote: Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Agent monthly limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit does not stop agent flows it calls.
claims.quote: Monthly limits that you set for an agent in the Power Platform admin center (Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents) don't stop the agent flows that the agent calls.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: The per-agent monthly limit is a general Copilot Credit spend control, not a self-learning availability switch.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents shows agent credit use.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio. ... Select Manage Agents. ... Agent: Review month-to-date billed credits, configured limits, and agent status.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure a notification threshold alongside an agent's monthly limit.
claims.quote: Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit. ... Configure the notification threshold.

claims.claim: Agent flow action consumption can be monitored separately.
claims.quote: To monitor credit consumption for agent flows, look for the Agent flow actions feature in the Copilot credit consumption details grid.
